questions.text: Describe the data structures used and why two are needed.
Walk through what lru_put does when the key is new and the cache is full.
Explain what the pointer-to-pointer in hash_remove does and why it is used.
What are the ownership rules for values and keys?

design_prompts.text: Is a single global mutex appropriate here? What would you do for high contention?
The eviction callback runs while the cache lock is held. What can go wrong?
Values are copied in and out of the cache. What are the trade-offs versus handing out a pointer?
How does the cache account for memory? Is the byte limit an accurate bound?
How is expiry implemented, and what are its costs?
